notes: x_I (South HST WL peak) is given with per-axis 1-sigma errors. The only X-ray position in the paper is the overall gas peak (Central concentration), which the paper places between the subclusters; the South X-ray concentration exists (Table 1) but has no stated position. Whether the Central gas peak counts as the South subcluster's 'stripped gas core' is an analyst decision; the paper does not attribute it to the South subcluster specifically. A stated offset G(central)-I(South) = 1.4' +/- 0.14 is available. No galaxy (S) position of any kind -> S missing. Coordinates are quoted to integer seconds of RA and integer arcsec of Dec (RA quantisation 1 s = ~13 arcsec on sky). Unit ambiguity of the RA errors (\fs) flagged above. North peak for reference: (09h16m10s +/-30s, 29d52m10s +/-30"). Pointer mismatch: Table 1 contains redshifts/masses/L_X/T_X/S/N but no positions; positions are in §5 text, not §3.
